title: centrosolenia pusilla
intro: Centrosolenia pusilla, commonly known as the dwarf firecracker, is a type of flowering plant in the family Acanthaceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antipyretic health benefits.
